title: Reinforcement Learning Enables Scaling Generalist Robot Policy Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2611.06905v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The introduction of generalist robot policies has enabled a single, large model to learn to perform a variety of tasks from a vast pre-training corpus. While these models often exhibit powerful zero-shot generalization capabilities, they typically require an adaptation phase to achieve sufficient performance in deployment. Iterated self-improvement via reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated promise in enabling this adaptation, yet such approaches have been largely explored in single-task settings - where the goal is to simply improve on a narrow deployment task - which lies in stark contrast to the multi-task capabilities of the base policy. In this work we ask whether generalist robot policies are capable of multi-task, generalist improvement in deployment - targeting many diverse tasks simultaneously - and what algorithmic recipe enables this. translated_title: 强化学习助力通用机器人策略改进的规模化
translated_abstract: 通用机器人策略的引入使得单个大型模型能够从庞大的预训练语料库中学习执行多种任务。尽管这些模型通常展现出强大的零样本泛化能力，但它们通常需要一个适应阶段才能在部署中达到足够的性能。通过强化学习（RL）进行迭代式自我改进在实现这种适应方面已展现出前景，然而此类方法主要在单任务设置中被探索——其目标仅仅是在狭窄的部署任务上进行改进——这与基础策略的多任务能力形成了鲜明对比。在本工作中，我们探究通用机器人策略是否能够在部署中实现多任务、通用性的改进——即同时针对众多多样化的任务——以及什么样的算法方案能够实现这一目标。为了回答这个问题，我们首先开发了一套结构化的评估方法来测试通...（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文探究并提出了让通用机器人策略通过强化学习在部署阶段实现多任务、通用性自我改进的算法方案，突破了以往仅能在单任务上进行优化的局限。
